claims.claim: The service is available to non-British, non-Irish nationals.
claims.quote: Who can use this service You can use this service to access an eVisa if you have: any visa for the UK (England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland) settlement in the UK
claims.note: The page describes eligible immigration statuses but does not state non-British and non-Irish nationality as the boundary.

claims.claim: A UKVI account and eVisa let a person view and prove their immigration status.
claims.quote: You need a UK Visas and Immigration ( UKVI ) account to access your eVisa.
claims.note: A UKVI account is expressly required to access the eVisa used by this service.

claims.claim: A share code is valid for 90 days.
claims.quote: A share code lasts for 90 days.
claims.note: The source gives the same duration.

claims.claim: A share code lets employers and landlords check your immigration status.
claims.quote: You can get a share code to prove your immigration status to people such as employers or landlords
claims.note: The source expressly names both employers and landlords.

claims.claim: People using the share code will see some of your personal details.
claims.quote: The person who uses your share code will see some of your personal details.
